items.title: Vincent Pelote interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 25, 2017
items.q: I guess I’d have to say the coolest thing is Lester Young’s tenor saxophone... I’m not even a horn player man, but I appreciate Prez man.

ctx.x: What is the coolest thing in the collection, as far as you’re concerned?
As far as I’m concerned, oh God. There’s just so many things. I mean but I guess I’d have to say the coolest thing is Lester Young’s tenor saxophone.
That’s what I would have said. Because I was only there the one time but, oh look —

items.title: Vincent Pelote interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 25, 2017
items.q: I’m not even a horn player man, but I appreciate Prez man.

ctx.x: That’s what I would have said. Because I was only there the one time but, oh look —

Yeah. There’s something magical about it. And I just look at it and I can see him holding it, that weird way he held the sax and everything, and those beautiful sounds coming out of that horn man. And I’m not even a horn player man, but I appreciate Prez man.
I love that moment that they captured on “The Sound of Jazz” with Lester and Billie.
